# Vendored: code_exec

`__init__.py` and `runner.py` are copied verbatim from [IvanMurzak/Code-Exec](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Code-Exec)
`python/code_exec/` at release **0.4.1** (tag `nuget-v0.4.1`, commit `2f46b50218148739ec05a1a315a4f3f41d4394e5`). Do not
edit them here: change Code-Exec and release it through the ai-game-dev release train (node `code-exec`), which
copies the files again and re-points this note and `UnrealMCP/ThirdPartyNotices.txt` at the released commit. The contract they implement is Code-Exec's `spec/contract.md` (sections 4 and 6: the runtime also clips the value, the logs and the error).
